Name:
⭐ And They Came Back / This One Here [V4]
(prod. James Blake & Dom Maker)
Notes: Following it's initial preview at a London Fashion Week afterparty on September 26th, 2022, this track, widely nicknamed "Showtime" by fans, quickly became considered to be one of the holy grails of the Ye community. This particular version features an extended intro with fully finished vocals from both Ye and James Blake, originally not known about until Ye himself would play it amongst other WAR files on a stream May 1st, 2025. In this intro, Ye mentions the idea of turning into birds after death, alluding to how Ye and Kim shared the belief that their deceased parents would visit them in spirit as crows, as mentioned in the 500 Days in UCLA documentary and in Ye's "Bad People" freestyle. Has two equally long Ye verses and a short Ye bridge that is repeated many times throughout the song. Track 9 on the October 2022 copy. Interpolates the bass melody from "Walk On the Wild Side" by Lou Reed. Original snippet leaked on Christmas Eve 2025. On Christmas Day 2025, a $10,000 fundraiser would coincidentally open and finish in less than 24 hours, with the song leaking shortly thereafter.
